summary: Design secure enterprise RAG pipelines, access controls, and evaluation plans. Explore the five-day practical course and review the curriculum.
lede: Enterprise RAG training helps data, MLOps, knowledge, architecture, and security professionals design governed retrieval workflows for organizational content. It covers assessing source readiness, mapping ingestion and indexing, and choosing retrieval methods while accounting for metadata and document permissions. Participants also develop evaluation plans for relevance and grounded answers, along with monitoring and threat-review artefacts to support deployment decisions.
audienceIntro: Enterprise RAG training is designed for professionals who make architecture, data, knowledge, model-operations, or security decisions about document-based AI systems.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of data architecture, enterprise content systems, or machine-learning concepts is recommended. Completion does not require programming; advanced topics such as embedding deployment and automated evaluation receive operational or conceptual treatment rather than hands-on engineering implementation.
